steps: The atomic number Z is the number of protons. It names the element.
The mass number A is protons plus neutrons. Neutrons = A − Z.
A neutral atom has electrons = protons.
A positive charge means electrons were lost. Electrons = Z − charge.
Type three numbers: protons, neutrons, electrons. Example: 6, 7, 6.

worked_example.q: Give protons, neutrons, and electrons for carbon-13.

similar_problem.q: Give protons, neutrons, and electrons for chlorine-37.
